js: (async () => { try { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notgta.opts') || '{}'); if (o.quality === 'hoch') return 'schon hoch, LOW_GFX=' + window.G.LOW_GFX; o.quality = 'hoch'; localStorage.setItem('notgta.opts', JSON.stringify(o)); setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 200); return 'neu laden'; } catch (e) { return 'EXC ' + e; } })()

(async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 170; i++) { if (window.G && document.body.innerText.includes('Frankfurt bereit')) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); } for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => /Rein da/.test(b.textContent)); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, i ? 5000 : 12000)); } return JSON.stringify({ q: window.G.opts.quality, low: window.G.LOW_GFX, dunst: /hazeP/.test(window.G.THREE.ShaderChunk.fog_fragment) }); })()
